informationClock.interpretation: Actual source acquisition is an upper bound on availability. Unknown publisher times remain null; market close, collection, cutoff and issuance are distinct.

issuanceMeaning: Actual candidate generation and immutable preservation; no production adoption

output.bandMeaning: Raw conditional pointwise Monte Carlo q10/q90; not scenario min/max, calibrated coverage or a simultaneous path band
output.medianMeaning: Pointwise simulated median; not guaranteed to be an individually realizable trajectory

simulation.bandMeaning: Conditional Monte Carlo 10th–90th percentiles, not validated 80% coverage or a simultaneous path band
simulation.centerMeaning: Pointwise median; generally not an individually realizable trajectory
simulation.sharedBlockLaw: Circular standardized return blocks; wraparound boundary assumed
